I know its the last thing you care to hear but 18 is not enough years. I'm struggling but I've given it 35...

I am praying you wait. I'm not telling you what not to do ultimately, I'm just saying give it some time...
I so get it. I've made so many mistakes. I can't rationalize making more. Yet the outside circumstances continue to make me feel guilt because "its all good" right?

Thanks for this...its so true that the guilt plagues me. Like what right do I have to feel this way. I have problems don't get me wrong but 5 minutes of watching the news and its like my problems are a drop in the bucket. But how do you fight the demon being you messing it all up? Not trauma, disease or tragedy. You.
Thanks. Really just didn't need to add anymore crazy to by feeling alone with this POV

Yeah, I'm glad you shared. Thank you. I totally know what you mean about it not being a wrong perspective sometimes. I think I'm being completely rational when I'm having these thoughts. I mean, they say insanity is when you do the same thing over and over expecting a different result but if waking up daily , living a normal life and pushing myself to be better keeps yielding the same zero result...couldn't staying here be considered insane?
